rca_of_issue: BUG-305: orderTransform.js was using full subtotal as denominator for discountRatio instead of discountableSubtotal, causing inflated GST reduction for non-discountable items. Fix: E1 adds _giveDiscount flag to cart items; E2 splits calcOrderTotals to track discountableSubtotal/Gst/Vat separately and compute discountableRatio; E3 mirrors the same split in buildBillPrintPayload. For cafe103 (all items discountable), new formula = old formula (math identity), confirming no regression.
